articleTitle: Chaotic Sparrow Search Algorithm Based Scheduling for Flexible Job Shop with Automatic Guided Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To solve the scheduling problem for a flexible job-shop with some automatic guided vehicles (AGVs), an improved chaotic sparrow algorithm is proposed to minimize the maximum completion time of jobs. Firstly, A mathematical model for the dual resource scheduling problem was established to optimize machines and AGVs simultaneously, and the two states of AGVs for both with and without loads were considered. Then, a chaotic sparrow search algorithm (CSSA) with feedback mechanism is proposed to balance search speed and convergence accuracy. A three-layer coding and greedy decoding of chaotic sparrow algorithm are designed to avoid it trapping in local optimal solution, and the Hénon chaotic mapping is used to improve the population diversity and convergence speed. Besides, an adaptive strategy improvement for safety values, discoverer as well as scout parameters, and multiple learning strategies are used. Finally, eight sets of standard arithmetic cases are selected for case study and simulation. The results show that the proposed algorithm CSSA has better optimization performance compared with the original sparrow search algorithm algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Fine-Grained Task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Edge computing is considered a promising architecture for handling latency-sensitive and computationally intensive tasks. The lack of consideration for the timing of jobs and their unique topology in the existing research on task scheduling in mobile edge computing settings results in performance deterioration and underutilization of edge servers. In this paper, we provide a two-tier, lightweight offloading mechanism. by carefully taking into account: 1) the job topology, 2) the task urgency, and 3) the rivalry for server resources. Simulation findings show that, as compared to baseline techniques, our proposed approach considerably increases application completion rates while reducing average system completion delay by 66.7% and 37.6% under various user and edge server counts.

articleTitle: Efficient and Enhanced Advanced Encryption Standard Algorithm with Chaos-Based Key Expansion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to address the increasing computational power and emerging attack methods, ensuring the security and confidentiality of data is of utmost importance. To overcome the limitations of the traditional AES encryption algorithm, an improved AES algorithm is proposed. The key expansion algorithm is enhanced by introducing a chaotic sequence, thereby improving the resistance of the round keys against attacks. Furthermore, the algorithm's computational complexity is significantly reduced by merging computational steps and utilizing lookup tables, resulting in a substantial improvement in execution efficiency. Experimental data comparisons demonstrate that the improved encryption algorithm possesses higher security and execution efficiency.

articleTitle: A Sensor-Based Smart Urban Flood Warning and Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid global climate change has resulted in frequent urban flooding disasters. The phenomenon of blocked drain covers in urban areas directly affects the passage of vehicles and pedestrians, causing inconvenience to citizens' travel. In severe cases, it can even submerge vehicles, leading to casualties and posing a serious threat to public safety and property. To address this issue, we propose a smart urban flood warning and management system. The system installs terminal devices on rainwater grates along the roadsides. When the water level on the road reaches a certain depth, pressure sensors are used to acquire the water level information, which is then uploaded to the server. The system provides realtime and accurate feedback on urban flooding conditions, demonstrating broad prospects for the prediction and control of urban flooding disasters.

articleTitle: Research on DCI Streaming Telemetry System Based on gNMI
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the explosive growth of network traffic, networks become more and more complex, and operators have more and more stringent requirements on network management. Aiming at the problems of high operation cost and low efficiency caused by large data volume of data center interconnection (DCI), a streaming telemetry system based on gRPC Network Management Interface (gNMI) is proposed in this paper. The telemetry system proposed in this paper allows continuous monitoring of optical communication system data. It can automate data acquisition of remote devices in DCI network and quickly report the data stream to the collector within a few seconds through compression technology, which can be used for real-time monitoring on demand and rapid fault location. In this paper, a telemetry system is implemented in the point-to-point DCI optical network equipment, which provides an effective guarantee for automatic operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: A Smooth Switching Scheme of Customer Edge Routers
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: At present, a number of customer edge (CE) routers used by communication operators cannot keep up with the business development, and urgently need to be replaced with newer and better devices. In practical applications, a pair of CE routers at the edge of the network usually use a hot-backup mechanism to provide redundancy. When replacing, it is necessary to replace both the hot-backup routers and minimize the impact on downstream services. This paper proposes a solution to smoothly replace Cisco brand CE routers with other brand routers. During the router replacement process, the private backup routing protocol used by Cisco routers is converted into a public protocol first to replace the two hot-backup routers one by one. Smoothness means that the proposed solution can improve the efficiency of engineering implementation without affecting downstream business.

articleTitle: Differential Evolution with Fitness-Based Niching and Adaptive Mutation for Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To handle the problem of premature convergence and premature loss of diversity in differential evolution, a niching method fitness-based and an adaptive mutation strategy differential evolution is proposed for global optimization. This algorithm designs a niche partitioning strategy that divides the population into niches with different numbers of individuals based on their fitness and evolutionary stages. Adopting adaptive mutation strategies for the obtained niches enhances the exploitation of superior niches and the exploration of inferior niches, thereby supporting balanced evolutionary search. On the CEC'2015 benchmark function test set, the suggested method's performance is assessed and contrasted with related methods. According to the outcomes, the suggested fitness-based niching and adaptive mutation schemes hold promise for enhancing DE performance.

articleTitle: Identification of Distribution Network Parameters Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Incomplete and inaccurate information of line parameters affects the condition monitoring, analysis and control of the distribution network. The accuracy of distribution network parameters is of great significance for its optimal operation. However, in recent years, the structure of distribution networks has become more and more complex, and there are large errors between the distribution network parameters and the actual values calculated by traditional theories. At the same time, there are errors in the actual measurement data, which makes it difficult to identify its parameter information accurately. Many current methods require the use of a large number of phasor measurement units to measure the phase angle of node voltages, which is currently not feasible for relatively conventional distribution networks. For this reason, this paper uses different parameter equations for the line for parameter identification by considering the presence or absence of phase measurement units <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\text{PMU}$</tex>. Firstly, the bad data are removed and then the parameter identification equation is derived and established by the formula, and the parameter identification is carried out by the particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the 13-node system is tested. The results verify the feasibility and good performance of the proposed parameter identification method, which is beneficial to the safe and stable operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research and Verification of the Scheme to Ensure Voice Over Wi-Fi Call Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Operators' cellular networks have problems such as weak coverage, insufficient deep coverage, and high-level pilot pollution, which lead to poor voice call experience. The VoWiFi service can make up for the above problems caused by the cellular network. However, V oWiFi also has many factors that affect its call quality. When Wi-Fi data services and VoWiFi services occur at the same time, this paper proposes a method to suspend other Wi-Fi data services to ensure VoWiFi call quality according to service priority, and verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Mask Wearing Detection Algorithm in Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, various viral outbreaks have had a huge impact on the world, and wearing masks has become an important public health measure. Incorrect wearing of masks can increase the risk of virus transmission, so how to detect and monitor the correctness of mask wearing has become an important research direction. However, complex factors such as occlusion, dense crowds, and small-scale targets often exist in natural scenes, which have an impact on the detection performance of wearing masks. To address this issue, a mask wearing detection algorithm incorporating attention mechanism is proposed based on the RetinaNet algorithm. Specifically, it is to establish a branch in the residual learning unit of the original target detection network RetinaNet, and incorporate an attention mechanism with feature recalibration characteristics into this branch. The idea of this attention mechanism originates from the human visual system. In deep learning, it can be understood as obtaining the importance of each feature map channel through feature learning, and then assigning weights to each channel based on this importance, thereby achieving the effect of enhancing useful information and suppressing useless information. Due to severe facial occlusion in densely populated scenes, incorporating attention mechanisms into the object detection network can better learn local features of the target by enhancing important information weights, thereby achieving better detection performance. The experimental results show that compared with YOLOv3 algorithm, the detection accuracy of this algorithm on facial targets and facial mask wearing targets is improved by 0.11% and 3.16%, with an average detection speed improvement of 2 FPS.

articleTitle: Intelligent Scheduling Strategy for Heterogeneous Multi-terminal Access Tasks for Complex Cloud-Edge Collaborative Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of network and mobile devices, the era of ten thousands households interconnection is gradually coming. The variety of applications is endless, putting higher demands on computing resources as well as latency. As a result, the task scheduling model of cloud-edge collaboration has emerged. In the current environment, due to the limited resources of edge nodes and the expanding volume of users and user data, how to allocate tasks to the best nodes becomes the most critical issue. To address this problem, this paper proposes the use of ant colony algorithm to optimize the cloud-edge collaborative task scheduling. The pheromone cumulative positive feedback method is mainly used to reflect the tendency of tasks to select processing devices. First, the probability of a processing device being selected by a task is calculated by pheromones. Then, a random number is used to determine the allocation strategy for each round of the cycle. Finally, the pheromone concentration of the processing device is updated and the minimum resource consumption as well as the optimal task assignment strategy is derived. The implementation results show that the ant colony algorithm can improve the response time, reduce the resource consumption, and improve the efficiency of multi-objective task scheduling.

articleTitle: Proxy Aggregation Signature Scheme with Forward Security
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of economy and society, data security has been the biggest issue that restricts social development. Based on the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem and the strong RSA hypothesis, we proposed a forward-aggregation proxy aggregation signature scheme. The scheme has the following characteristics: Firstly, it has non-repudiation and realizes two-way verification of signed users and trusted centers. Secondly, the scheme has forward security and ensures the security of signature information. Finally, under the random oracle model It proves that the scheme is anti-existence forgery.

articleTitle: Relay Scheduling of Heterogeneous Tasks in NOMA Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In this study, we investigate relay selection for latency-sensitive tasks in the context of NOMA (Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access) mode. Our objective is to enhance the stability of transmission and improve signal quality in satellite links, while also alleviating spectrum scarcity issues in ground base stations. To achieve this, we propose a three-layer relay architecture model in NOMA mode, utilizing distributed channel resource allocation through edge cloud servers to reduce decision complexity for satellites. Our aim is to minimize overall task transmission time, enhance task completion rates, and meet the minimum transmission rate requirements for ground base station users. By extracting user transmission information from ground base station configuration files and assigning priorities based on task characteristics, we employ iterative matching to determine relay selection for each satellite user. We conduct a detailed analysis of the impact of key factors on the performance of our proposed scheme and highlight the advantages of NOMA mode in relay systems.

articleTitle: Protection of Express Information Using Parallel Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In daily life, our express information items are stored in the server of express company. To avoid the leakage of the users' private information, this paper proposes a fast encryption algorithm to protect them. The proposed method first creates multiple threads. Then the information items are grouped into multiple groups with the same number of threads. Next, each thread employs a chaos-based encryption algorithm to encrypt the express information. Finally, the proposed method output the ciphered express information. Security analysis and efficiency test are carried out, and the results show that the proposed method can resist brute-force attack, statistical analysis, and have high efficiency compared with serial encryption mode.

articleTitle: A Symmetric Nonconvex Method for MRI
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging is an essential tool for clinical diagnosis, but acquisition time and reconstruction errors have always been bottleneck issues limiting the development of this field. In this paper, we use SCAD nonconvex function to construct a new MRI reconstruction nonconvex model, which can overcome the shortcomings of the traditional convex model. In model solving, considering the symmetry ADMM method improves the image reconstruction performance while increasing the reconstruction speed. The experiment shows that the method proposed in this paper has significant improvements over traditional TV methods.

articleTitle: An SRIO Bus-Based Implementation of a High-Speed Interface for Satellite 5G
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The current low-orbiting satellite constellation is evolving towards a 5G communication system, and traditional satellite communication methods can hardly meet the needs of 5G applications. The implementation of 5G protocols requires the support of high speed and broad bandwidth data transmission. To solve the problems of low transmission rate, small bandwidth and poor reliability in large data volume transmission systems, a solution is proposed for the implementation of an SRIO bus-based onboard 5G protocol. The solution enables high-speed transfer of large amounts of data between the FPGA and the CPU. The design uses XILINX's SRIO IP core and the Rapid IO module embedded in the CPU to send, parse and receive the transmitted data. The design has been tested for accuracy and reliability with data transfer rates up to 3.5Gbps. It effectively solves the problem of high-speed and reliable transmission of large amounts of data between the FPGA and the CPU under the satellite 5G communication system. The solution has been successfully applied to the communication test project of the LEO constellation.

articleTitle: Domain Adaption for Building Extraction from Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Due to the scarcity of remote sensing image annotation data and low model generalization ability, automatically extracting buildings from different remote sensing images remains a challenging problem. A domain adaption framework is proposed for building extraction from remote sensing images and tested on Inria aerial image labeling dataset. Results show that domain adaption is beneficial to improve the accuracy of building extraction in the target domain.

articleTitle: A Desensitization Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv7-tiny
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of smart cars, many high-precision cameras have been applied to cars, which means that more videos will be processed through the vehicle computer network, which also leads to the problem of information leakage. To address these issues, a video desensitization processing model is proposed, which desensitizes the license plate and facial information in high-definition videos, maximizing privacy protection without losing video clarity and vehicle recognition accuracy. This model is based on YOLOv7-tiny for improvement and upgrading. GSConv is used to replace the original convolution to reduce model parameters and improve running speed. The original neck structure is improved, and a GSN framework structure is proposed to replace YOLOv7-tiny's original ELAN structure, further improving model accuracy.

articleTitle: Kinematics Parameter Analysis of Long Jump Based on Human Posture Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to enable long jumpers or coaches to accurately analyze each training result and help athletes improve their performance, this paper designs a method of analyzing the kinematic parameters of long jump based on human posture vision. Firstly, the attitude recognition model is used to analyze the athlete's posture, and the key point position information of the athlete is given. At the same time, the trajectory of the movement is accurately tracked through perspective transformation and background difference, and the kinematic parameters of the long jump are obtained based on the trajectory.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of SVMs Model Optimized by Machine Learning Methods in Water Quality Assessment of Dongting Lake
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper presents 15 SVM models optimized by machine learning methods in water quality assessment. Through comparative analysis, we found that all the models reached reasonable accuracy during the training and testing process. In particular, SAA-SVM-PI, GWO-SVM-PI, GWO-SVM-TN, PSO-SVM-TP models have the highest accuracy, the highest squared correlation and the lowest mean squared error when testing the three indexes of PI, TN and TP. In order to study the spatial distribution characteristics of water quality in Dongting Lake, GWO-SVM-PI, GWO-SVM-TN and PSO-SVM-TP models were respectively used for single-factor water quality classification. The results showed that: As far as the PI is concerned, the water quality is mainly in grade I and II; As far as TN is concerned, the water quality is mainly of grade IV and V, with the worst water quality in the East Dongting Lake and the outlet profile; In terms of TP, the water quality is mainly of grade III, IV and V, with the best inlet water quality, the worst water quality in the South Dongting Lake.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Competency Evaluation of Vocational Undergraduate Students Based on multi-layer ER Rules
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems in the evaluation of the comprehensive ability of vocational undergraduates and analyze the requirements of vocational undergraduates for the comprehensive ability of college students, study the problems of the index system and existing methods for evaluation problems, and propose a model for assessing the comprehensive ability of vocational undergraduates based on multilayer evidential reasoning rules. Evidential reasoning rule is an intelligent information fusion algorithm developed and extended based on Dempster-Shafer evidence theory, which can deal with the problems of diversifying evaluation information, describing the uncertainty of assessment information, and considering the reliability of evaluation information. The model firstly analyzes diversified information using natural language processing methods and standardizes it using rule/utility methods to realize data analysis and mining of diversified information; secondly, it uses hierarchical analysis and mathematical statistics methods to solve the weight and reliability of indicator information; finally, it realizes the fusion of diversified information based on evidence-based inference rules to evaluate the comprehensive ability of vocational undergraduates. The model is multilevel and interpretable, and can realize the combination of stage evaluation and result evaluation. Validate the effectiveness of the method through case study.

articleTitle: Eye Diagram Generation Algorithm Based on Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of 5G communication technology, many communication devices or circuits need to be tested in several GHz or tens of GHz frequency bands. The characteristics of interconnected devices become more complex as the signal transmission rate increases, so the ability to maintain signal integrity has to be considered, and to maximize the device characteristics, it is necessary to obtain time-frequency domain information at the same time. In order to solve this problem, this paper presents an algorithm of converting S-parameter measured by vector network analyzer into time domain, and then generating eye diagram, which can be used to analyze the ability of signal transmission and obtain time domain information. In the experiment, S-parameters were measured by ADS simulation and vector network analyzer, and the clear open eye diagram is obtained, which verifies the correctness of the algorithm and the feasibility of the algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: RFID Based Item-Level Leaking Sensing in Densely Deployed Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Due to the environmentally sensitive character, passive Ultra High Frequency Radio Frequency IDentification (UHF RFID) has shown tremendous potential for wireless sensing. This paper makes use of the fact that electromagnetic radiation affected by liquids to detect liquid leakage from a group of densely deployed objects. As the most common RFID metric, received signal strength indicator (RSSI) is very sensitive to environmental changes, hence the changes of RSSI value are used to monitoring the leaking. The results demonstrated that the leaking liquid item exhibited the greatest variation in RSSI fluctuation values compared to the other items with no leaking. Therefore, RSSI changes would play a vital role in a leaking monitoring even in dense deployment.

articleTitle: MII-DFNet: A Medical Image Inpainting Framework Based on Deep Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Since medical images are easily captured with missing areas due to uncertainties such as instrument or human factors, which can seriously affect doctors' diagnosis and patients' treatment, medical image inpainting techniques have become very important. How to make the restored images not only rich in structural and textural information, but also smooth transitions in the boundary regions to blend into the adjacent regions of the missing parts has always been a research focus in the field of computer vision. In order to address the above problems, this paper proposes a medical image inpainting framework (MII-DFNet) based on deep fusion network, through which the medical images covered by mask are restored to complement the original information. And two common medical images, CT and MRI, are used as our test datasets to verify the performance of the model. The experiments show that our method is better in restoration and generates higher quality images.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Text Processing Method for Power Grid Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The existing power grid dispatch automation system lacks the ability to comprehend natural language information. This limitation hampers the efficiency of operating personnel when they read and process power grid operation event information, which is often presented in the form of natural language sentences. These personnel can only manually search for relevant event information from a vast array of unordered sentences, leading to inefficiencies and increased chances of errors. To address this issue, this article proposes a data synthesis processing model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks. This model effectively handles large batches of Chinese short textual sequences by considering their contextual correlations. To align with the format of the composite information system, the model converts Chinese short texts into English letters and numerical short sequences. Moreover, the proposed model analyzes the contextual relationships within the text to identify the types of equipment described in each short text entry. It then generates the corresponding event codes and device codes for each entry. By employing this model, power grid operation event information can be processed, enabling the identification and classification of power grid operation events based on equipment and behavior. Consequently, this enhances the understanding of power grid operators and enables further processing by other business systems, thereby elevating the intelligence level of the power system as a whole.

articleTitle: Research on Course Recommendation System Based on Portrait Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous integration of information technology and education, the course resource sharing platform has rapidly developed and accumulated tens of thousands of learning data, which includes a large amount of behavior information, interaction information, learning effect evaluation information, etc. How to mine the intrinsic value of data and meet the diverse learning needs of different users has become an urgent problem to be solved. Therefore, we propose a course recommendation system based on portrait technology. The system models user portraits and course portraits through basic data and historical learning data, and deeply mines educational data based on course recommendation algorithms, so as to recommend courses that match their interests and abilities for users. The course recommendation system based on portrait technology can not only be used to evaluate students' learning behavior and interest preferences, but also can formulate personalized learning strategies for different users to meet the learning needs of different users.

articleTitle: Control Algorithm for CAV Cooperative Lane Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Intelligent connected technology is the future development trend of intelligent transport system, however, the new hybrid traffic flow composed of Connected and Autonomous Vehicle (CAV) and Human-Driven Vehicle (HDV) will exist for a long time. The current research on lane control of mixed traffic flow mainly focuses on the right-of-way allocation under different CAV penetration rates, without fully considering the active adaptation capability of CAV and its bidirectional interaction with the traffic control system. In this paper, we propose the concept of CAV cooperative lanes, which are placed in CAV-specific lanes, and control the lane-changing rules of CAVs in cooperative lanes and mixed lanes through policy algorithms to achieve traffic control of specific objectives. Taking a three-lane motorway scenario as an example, a combination of four different control methods is proposed to achieve three CAV control strategies. The aim is to consider optimising the degree of vehicle aggregation in the traffic flow, while reducing the interaction between different types of vehicles through lane changing. Experimental results show that the CAV control algorithm proposed in this paper has a good improvement in traffic flow, travel time and CAV operational status. Therefore, the CAV cooperative lane control algorithm can give full play to the characteristics of two-way interaction of the CAV traffic control system, which is a new control method in the mixed traffic flow environment.

articleTitle: Extraction and Association Co-Occurrence Analysis of Hotwords in Tibetan Web
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Hotwords mining is an important part of network public opinion analysis research, and has been applied successfully to Chinese and English texts, but the research on minority languages is still in its infancy. This paper proposes a hotwords extraction algorithm for Tibetan web texts and mines the association among hotwords in order to provide a reference for the subsequent research on Tibetan opinion analysis. Firstly, a large number of Tibetan articles were collected from the Internet to construct the corpus. Then the corpus was divided into four parts according to the release time. Based on the word frequency, we introduced the position and the length weight to calculate the words weight, and extract the hotwords of the four time periods. Finally, the frequent itemset extraction method in association rule mining was used to obtain the frequent co-occurrence word sets from Tibetan text and it is analyzed to track relevant hot events. The analyses show that the hotwords extracted by the algorithm in this paper can effectively reflect the propaganda focus of the websites and the focus of the Tibetan people in different time periods.

articleTitle: Development of Drilling Rig Open-Hole Orientator Based on RKF Rotation Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to meet the application requirements of high-precision, low-cost, and fast open-hole orientation of intelligent drilling rigs in coal mines. In this paper, a rotation modulation algorithm based on RKF (robust Kalman filter) is proposed, and the development of drilling rig open-hole orientator is completed for this method. Firstly, the traditional four-position open-hole orientation method is analyzed, and the RKF rotation modulation method is introduced according to its current problems, and the overall design scheme of the open-hole orientation is described on this basis. Finally, the performance experiment was carried out for the prototype, and the pitch angle error was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.24^{\circ}$</tex>, the tool face angle error was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.01^{\circ}$</tex>, the north seeking time was 40s, the north seeking accuracy was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.81^{\circ}$</tex> and the standard deviation of 10 measurements was 0.1, which met the requirements of the orientation index of the intelligent drilling rig, which confirmed the excellent potential of the new drilling rig open-hole orientator.

articleTitle: RSSI Fluctuation Analysis for RFID Tagged and Untagged Liquid Object
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Based on its unique backscatter communication principle, RFID technology enables RFID tags to detect changes in liquid environments. As the density of deployed tags increases, tag interference becomes an unavoidable factor influencing the precision of RF signal measurements, particularly for tagged objects. Therefore, it becomes more crucial to comprehend the tendency of signal fluctuation under the combined influence of liquid and tag interference. In this paper, the most common sensing characteristic, received signal strength indicator (RSSI) of RF signals, is examined under two example cases: RFID-tagged and untagged glass vessels filled with water. The RSSI fluctuation depicts the channel fluctuations caused by liquid and tag interference. The experimental results indicate that tagged objects may induce different fluctuation values for liquid object, but it could still be used in sensing applications as the RSSI values of the fixed tags fluctuate with essentially the same period and decrease with increasing spacing distance when glass vessels contain varying volumes of water with or without RFID tags.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Decentralized Federated Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As a decentralized technology, blockchain has the characteristics of traceability and immutability. Using blockchain technology, each model update of federation information can be associated with each participant, and the traceability of transactions in the blockchain can be used to detect fraudulent transactions that attempt to tamper with data. At the same time, the blockchain is used to realize the decentralization of the system, which strengthens the fault tolerance and attack resistance of the system. Based on this, this chapter designs and implements a blockchain architecture to solve the problem of safe and trusted data sharing among participants in the decentralized federated learning model. A blockchain architecture is designed and implemented for decentralized federated learning, using the blockchain to store the model parameter information of participants in each round of training; in view of the shortcomings of existing consensus algorithms, combined with decentralized federated learning detection model, A new consensus algorithm - “High Performance Byzantine Fault Tolerance Based on Model Accuracy” consensus algorithm is proposed.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network-Assisted Power Prediction for Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The power prediction of photovoltaic (PV) power generation is important to reduce the impact of PV grid connection and maintain the grid's secure and stable operation. However, the power prediction for PV power station still has the problem of poor prediction accuracy. To address the problem, this paper proposes a back propagation (BP) neural network-assisted power prediction method for PV power station, which can achieve realtime and high-accuracy power prediction by effectively training a BP neural network model. First, the power prediction architecture for PV power station is constructed. Then, the BP neural network-assisted power prediction algorithm is proposed to provide accurate PV power prediction. Simulation results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed algorithm in prediction deviation.

articleTitle: Cost Risk Assessment of Power Transmission and Transformation Project Based on MCS-GA-ELM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: China's power industry is promoting reforms in energy types and data processing. The construction of power transmission and transformation projects, which occupy an important position in the power construction industry, has a high degree of cost risk due to its wide scope and long duration, which can easily have adverse effects on the construction of the power industry. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the cost risk of power transmission and transformation projects. On the basis of reading relevant literature, establish a cost risk set for power transmission and transformation engineering, analyze and screen out 15 influencing factors, and use the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) algorithm of Genetic Algorithm (GA) to train the prediction model. After verification, the model accuracy reached 0.99874, indicating that the model established in the study meets the prediction needs. Finally, using this model to analyze risk assessment examples, Monte Carlo simulation (MCS) was introduced, and it was found that the excess risk of the project cost reached 59.94%, indicating a high risk. Corresponding measures should be taken to control it. Research has shown that the establishment of the MCS-GA-ELM model can play an auxiliary role in predicting and controlling the cost risk assessment of power transmission and transformation projects, providing a new approach for cost risk assessment of power transmission and transformation projects.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dictionary Learning Data Compression Algorithm for Distributed Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to promote the development of a low-carbon economy, many solar energy industries have emerged. The distributed photovoltaic power generation system can directly convert solar energy into electricity, which is a new type of clean and environmentally friendly system. The information monitoring network in the system provides photovoltaic power generation system data to help the power grid achieve collaborative optimization. In order to reduce the energy consumption in the data transmission process, an adaptive dictionary learning data compression algorithm based on compressed sensing theory is proposed. With the application of compressed sensing theory, it combines the sampling and compression process of signals, breaking the limitations of traditional Nyquis's theorem and greatly reducing the time of data processing. This paper combines adaptive dictionary learning with compressed sensing theory, first using input signal data for sparse coding, training adaptive dictionary to achieve rapid data compression, and finally using compressed sensing theory to reconstruct data.

articleTitle: Research on Survivability of Intelligent Combat Network Based on Composite Virtual Link
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The changes brought about by the progress of productivity will radiate to the military field, and joint operations have gradually become the mainstream of development. Complex networks are the core of joint operations. The development and progress of weapons and equipment have made intelligent warfare a trend, but there is relatively little research on intelligent warfare networks and their related characteristics such as survivability. This paper studies the survivability of intelligent combat networks based on a composite intelligent combat network model coupled with virtual links, and analyzes the survivability of networks under different attack modes. And based on the performance in actual warfare, simulation was conducted on the intelligent combat network of participating forces, proving that the intelligent combat network has stronger survivability.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Recommendation Algorithm Based on Knowledge Path
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the Internet, all kinds of information have widely flooded the Internet, and this information can be used to create various applications and improve and supplement the current applications. In this case, aiming at the traditional item-based collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm that can only use simple purchasing information and ignore many network information and others, this paper proposes a novel approach to determine the similarity of entities based on the path of knowledge graphs and applies it to the item-based collaborative recommendation approach. By analyzing the entities, relationships, and their structural characteristics in knowledge graphs, the similarity of entities, such as goods, is determined. The accuracy of the recommendation is further improved by combining this approach with the traditional item-based collaborative recommendation. Experiments show this approach can further improve the recommendation accuracy of the traditional item-based collaborative recommendation approach.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Computing Security Based on Virtualization Security Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of high intrusion rate and low encryption depth of traditional cloud computing security research methods, this paper proposes a new cloud computing security research method based on Virtualization security technology. First, analyze the principle of virtualization technology, and build a cloud computing resource transmission model to understand the whole cloud computing process. Secondly, the chaotic mapping method is used to transform cloud computing data to obtain binary chaotic sequence data, and realize the security encryption of cloud computing data to further ensure the security of cloud computing data. Finally, build the cloud computing data encryption and decryption algorithm to complete the cloud computing security research. Experimental results show that compared with traditional methods, the proposed method can effectively improve the security of cloud computing and reduce the intrusion rate.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Sparse Bayesian Channel Estimation Algorithm for OTFS Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) channel estimation in the OTFS system, a hierarchical SBL channel estimation algorithm with adaptive adjusted hyperparameters is adopted. Firstly the algorithm transforms the channel estimation problem into a sparse signal recovery problem based on the sparsity of the delay-Doppler domain channel using the principle of compressed sensing. Secondly the sparse signal is modeled as a three-layer a priori SBL(T-SBL) model. Finally, a particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm with high global seeking capability is proposed to optimize the sensing matrix for the effect of the nonorthogonality of the sensing matrix on the algorithm. The simulation results show that the T -SBL algorithm improves the normalized mean square error (NMSE) performance of OTFS system in low SNR environment, and the BER performance of the system can be effectively enhanced when the T -SBL algorithm is used to estimate the channel after optimizing the sensing matrix.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Water Quality Based on Gray Wolf Optimization and Support Vector Machines (GWO-SVM): A Case Study from Dongting Lake, China
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Water quality assessment is an essential part of water resource management. This paper presents a new GWO-SVM method for water quality assessment. Through comparison with GS-SVM and GA-SVM, we found that GWO-SVM model has the highest accuracy, the highest squared correlation and the lowest mean squared error when testing the three indexes of PI, TN and TP.The GWO-SVM model proposed in this paper was used to analyze the water quality data of Dongting Lake from 1993 to 2012. The results showed that: As far As the PI is concerned, the water quality is mainly in grade I and II, with the best water quality in autumn and 2008-2012.As far As TN is concerned, the water quality is mainly of grade IV and V,With the best water quality in autumn and the worst in spring, water quality was the best from 2003 to 2007 and the worst from 2008 to 2012.In terms of TP, the water quality is mainly of grade III,IV and V, with the best inlet water quality, the worst water quality In the south dongting lake, the best water quality In summer,The best water quality between 1993 and 1997, and the worst water quality between 2003 and 2007.

articleTitle: Smart Contracts and Reputation-Based Access Control Solutions for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the increase of IoT (Internet of Things) application scenarios, traditional access control technology can no longer meet the security needs of device access control in IoT scenarios. There are problems such as inadequate security of stored information, difficulty in controlling access rights at a fine-grained level, and untimely handling of malicious access behavior in IoT. To address these problems, an ABAC(attribute based access control) model is used as the basis for access control, and a smart contract based on attribute and reputation access control model is proposed. The solution divides the access control process into four parts and uses a combination of smart contracts and the ABAC model to achieve traceable, automated and trusted access control to the entire IoT resources. Finally, the effectiveness and compatibility of the smart contract and reputation-based access control model is verified through simulation experiments and performance tests.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Federated Learning for Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Smart home devices generate a substantial amount of local data, and finding effective ways to utilize this data while ensuring privacy has become an increasingly pressing concern. Technologies such as Smart Homes, Federated Learning and Blockchain offer promising solutions to address this challenge. We introduce a blockchain-based federated learning approach that leverages edge nodes to maintain a decentralized blockchain, thus mitigating the risks associated with single points of failure. Furthermore, this method utilizes local data from home IoT devices for model training, ensuring efficient learning while preserving data privacy. To address the challenges posed by non-independent and homogeneous data distribution, we propose a clustering method. This strategy effectively tackles the issues arising from non-homogeneous data distribution, consequently improving model accuracy. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach significantly enhances model accuracy and generalization while safeguarding user privacy.

articleTitle: SSD Multi-Level Parallel Garbage Collection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Solid-state drives (SSDs) based on NAND flash memory have the advantages of fast access speed, low power consumption and high reliability, have been widely used in storage systems. However, I/O requests from users may be significantly affected by SSD internal garbage collection (GC), and GC operations have always been the core issue limiting SSD performance. In order to solve the problem, this paper proposes a multi-level parallel garbage collection scheme (MP-GC) based on the new SSD flash memory chip architecture. In this scheme, the page-level parallelism and plane-level parallelism of GC operations are realized through the new SSD flash memory chip architecture, the valid pages in the victim block are migrated in parallel, and the victim blocks of multiple planes are reclaimed in parallel. This scheme reduces the time of the GC process and reclaims more invalid pages within a given erasure time. It can also delay future GC operations and effectively reduce the frequency of GC. We extend Flashsim to implement and evaluate our scheme. The experimental results show that compared with the GC scheme based on the traditional SSD flash memory chip architecture, MP-GC reduces the total GC time by 58.2% and the latency by 40% on average.

articleTitle: An Innovative Similar Complaint Recommendation Model Integrating Semantic and Graph Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence plays a vital role in driving the intelligentization of the complaint hotline 12345. To assist hotline operators in accurately understanding public demands and allocating them to municipal departments, we propose BERT-Graph that recommends historical complaint to pending complaint through a dual-tower recommendation model integrating semantic and graph embeddings. Since the complaint records are sparse, colloquial and similar complaint texts may transcribed semantically different by operators, we construct an event interact graph for the complaint text to avoid implying sole reliance on semantic information. We consider each complaint text as a node, the co-occurrence times of key words calculated by TF-IDF between texts as weighted edges, and we use the Graph Attention Network (GAT) to obtain graph embeddings. After obtaining the semantic embedding through pre-trained language model BERT, we concat it with the graph embedding and feed it to the dual-tower model. We add a self-attention module as the neural network in the dual-tower model and we use a fully connected layer to output the similarity score of the input texts. Experimental results on complaint hotline 12345 datasets of the Chinese city of Wuhan demonstrate that compared to other baseline models, BERT-Graph shows a significant improvement on the Mean Squared Error (MSE) metric, from 0.86 to 0.24.

articleTitle: Multiple Acoustic Sources Location Based on MUSIC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: During the development of lightning, there may be multiple lightning sources sounding simultaneously, thus leads to the mixing of lightning signals and increases the difficulty of lightning location. The identification and location of multiple lightning sources are of practical significance to the research of the physical mechanism of lightning channel development. In this paper, a spiral-spherical microphone array previously proposed by author's research group is used to acquire the pulse signal generated by the horn which simulated thunder. Then based on the Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) algorithm, the acoustic source location results are obtained to detect the accuracy of the system. The results show that the recognition and location of multiple acoustic sources can be accurately obtained. The generation of grating lobes can be well suppressed, the obvious fake acoustic sources can be effectively avoided and the average measured result matches the theoretical value. So the designed location system meets expectations. This paper lays a theoretical and practical foundation for the follow-up field observation and research of thunder.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Parallel Computing Technique Using on the Numerical Simulation of Carbon Free Fuel
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The numerical simulation of the turbulent combustion is identified as one of the most promising methods on the designs of the combustion devices, for example: the internal combustion engine and gas turbine. This mainly depends on the development of parallel computing technique. However, the computational efficiency for different cases on different compute nodes and number of cores still needs to be studied. On the other hand, due to the requirements from the aim of peaking carbon dioxide emissions before 2030 and achieving carbon neutrality before 2060, modern energy system is requesting low carbon or carbon free fuels, such as ammonia (NH3). Therefore, the simulations of ammonia/air flame were performed in present investigation. The comparison between simulation cases on different compute nodes and number of cores illustrates that different cases requires different number of cores to achieve the best computational efficiency. The computational efficiency of each compute nodes are dissimilar, which can decrease the efficiency. Meanwhile, the methods in present study can predict the ammonia/air flames. The initial condition of velocity fluctuation is necessary for simulating turbulent flame. The wrinkles of the flames can be well predicted by the velocity fluctuation initial boundary condition.

articleTitle: Optimization of Access Address Calculation for LLVM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As an open-source compiler architecture that is continuously being improved, LLVM generates a relatively inefficient access address calculation instruction that involve a large number of redundant calculations. This issue seriously impacts the efficiency of memory access and hinders the performance of the processor. This paper proposes an optimization method for accelerating the computation of the access address, aiming at the low efficiency of the existing access address calculation. This method first merges part of the calculation instructions in the address calculation instruction to reduce the redundancy calculation, so as to complete the optimization of a single access address calculation instruction. For multiple merged address calculation instructions, it is necessary to decompose the offset, and reorganize the operand with the decomposed operand information to generate the instruction matrix. The instructions in the matrix are then used for instruction match, and using the instruction which match successfully to adjusts the position of the operands in the sequence by instruction replacement, thus optimizing multiple access address calculation instructions. This optimization method can significantly improve the quality of compiler-generated code and effectively accelerate access. A performance evaluation is conducted on the industry-standard performance benchmark suite SPEC CPU2006. The results show that after using memory address calculation optimization, the overall performance improves by 1.35% compared to the original compiler. The average performance of the two benchmark test programs, SPECint and SPECfp, improve by1.51% and 1.22%, respectively.

articleTitle: Network Topology Analysis of NCW Based on SPDI Model and Modularity Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Recent years, network-centric warfare (NCW) has become a hot topic in the global military theory circle. The NCW operation style, which shows the characteristics of precision strike, flexible maneuvering, platform integration and so on. In this article, we abstract the combat entities of NCW as nodes and construct the SPDI model. Based on the modularity optimization algorithm in Gephi, we make an in-depth study on the topology structure of the combat network and analyze the characteristics. The specific methods are as follows: First, we take NCW as a sample and abstract the combat network topology based on SPDI model. Then, relying on the modularity optimization algorithm in Gephi, we obtain the optimal community division. Last, according to the combat network topology and the optimal community division, we analyze the degree distribution and community structure, and find the key nodes in different node types, together with the local areas which have greater influence on the whole network.

articleTitle: 3 D Transmission Line Path Selection Method Based on Nested Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Objective: Digital three-dimensional design is a technology that is vigorously promoted by the current transmission and transformation line engineering, which will promote the existing design and process from 2 D to three-dimensional. Based on this paper, we explore the advantages of nested genetic algorithm in the selection of transmission and transformation line path from the perspective of three-dimensional model. Methods: This paper first analyzes the basic principle of nested genetic algorithm and demonstrates the plane linear model. Then, using the actual case as a comparison, the transmission line was optimized, and excellent results were obtained. Results: Compared to the transmission line path optimization results of the actual established path. Conclusion: Considering the comprehensive cost, the comprehensive cost of the used algorithm is lower than the actual established pathConsidering the comprehensive cost Dijkstra optimization method yields shorter paths and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Dim Target Detection Algorithm Based on Multi-Scale Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of small and dim target with relatively few pixels, difficult to extract pixel features, low detection probability and high false alarm rate. In this paper, an algorithm based on multi-scale feature enhancement for dim target detection is proposed. Starting from the upper layer of detection task, the image high-resolution reconstruction network based on pyramid architecture is first used to strengthen the small and target region and distribution features, and then the reconstructed target features are sent as learning labels into the Yolo v5s detection framework containing multi-channel convolution kernel for self-supervised learning. Through the case test with different number of target points, it is proved that the mAP value of the enhanced image is more than 4% higher than that of the original image.

articleTitle: CNN-based Steganalysis Detects Adversarial Steganography via Adversarial Training and Feature Squeezing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Deep learning model's vulnerability and unreliability cannot be ignored. For example, adversarial steganography exploits adversarial examples to escape the recognition of CNN-based steganalyzer, which is a pressing issue for intelligent steganalysis algorithms. In this paper, we propose a steganalysis method that can effectively detect adversarial steganography via adversarial training and feature squeezing. Firstly, we train the steganalyzer based on the adversarial cover and stego images with small perturbations to improve the robustness of the steganalyzer, which can effectively identify small perturbations of samples. Additionally, the proposed steganalysis decreases the utilization space of adversarial attacks by squeezing the input samples' features throughout the detection phase. The results of our experiments demonstrate that the accuracy of detecting adversarial steganography may be effectively improved by the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Data Storage Security in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper conducts in-depth research and discussion on data storage security in cloud computing environment. This study collected 1000 dummy data from different organizations as the basic data set for the study. This data covers various types of sensitive information, including personally identifiable information, financial data, and medical records. We generate these data using appropriate data generation methods to ensure realistic characteristics and distributions. Based on existing backup technologies and algorithms, we evaluate the impact of different backup strategies on data security. Experimental results show that our data backup and recovery strategy and the application of encryption technology effectively improve the security of data in cloud storage. By selecting backup strategies and recovery mechanisms reasonably, we can ensure data availability and integrity. At the same time, employing a proper encryption scheme can protect data from the risk of unauthorized access and disclosure.

articleTitle: A multi-stage detection method for insulator defects based on super-resolution reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: For the problems of small objects of insulator defects and insignificant texture features in UAV power inspection images, a multi-stage insulator defect detection method is proposed based on MSR-Net and YOLOv5-s. Firstly, the YOLOv5-s network is applied to quickly identify the insulators in the images. Secondly, a multi-scale super-resolution network (MSR-Net) is proposed to reconstruct the insulators image. Due to the introduction of residual structure, normalized coordinate grid, and multi-scale data mixed training strategy, the high-frequency feature extraction capability and multi-scale generalization capability of the network have been improved, which can significantly enhance the characteristics of insulator defect small objects. Finally, input high-resolution image into YOLOv5-s network again to reidentify insulator defect more effectively. The test results on the self-built datasets show that the average detection accuracy and average detection speed of the proposed insulator defect detection method reach 88.04% and 5.24FPS, respectively, which effectively improves the accuracy of small object detection of insulator defects. The proposed method can be widely used in power inspection and other small object detection scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Landscape Lighting Control System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In view of the insufficient adaptability between the lighting fixture wiring and the control system, as well as the problem of asynchronous video playback among multiple players due to random frame loss, this paper presents an optimized design of the landscape lighting control system based on Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). In-depth research is conducted on the arrangement of pixel data and extraction of video frame numbers in the system. Firstly, a landscape lighting control system is built with the aim of achieving landscape lighting display. Subsequently, pixel data addressing and package modules are introduced to enhance the system's adaptability to lighting fixture layout and wiring. Furthermore, a video frame number extraction module is designed to accurately extract specific frame data and ensure its transmission within the system, thereby avoiding frame loss. Experimental verification demonstrates that the system can adapt to different lighting fixture wiring requirements and ensure synchronization of video playback across multiple players. This optimization solution improves the system's universality and flexibility, providing strong support for the development of landscape lighting control systems.

articleTitle: An Optimized Storage Method for Small Files in Ceph System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the scene of massive small files, there are a lot of data holes and redundant metadata in the distributed storage system based on Ceph, resulting in a waste of storage space. And the network consumption, PG(placement group) mutex and IO order preservation in the IO path will affect the IO performance. In order to solve the above problems, an online small file merging storage method is proposed. This method uses the relevance judgment module based on Crush (controlled replication under scalable hashing) to group the small files, and merges the small file data in the request context. When merging, the CV(condition variable) pool method is used to synchronize the threads in the same merging group. After merging, small files are stored sequentially and share the same metadata. In addition, this method optimizes the deletion of merged small files, and only records GC(garbage collection) logs when deleting, and garbage data is cleaned asynchronously by GC threads. The experimental results show that this method can improve the writing performance of small files by 62%, reduce data holes by 80% and reduce metadata by 50%.

articleTitle: Sentences Similarity Model Based on Fusion of Semantic, Syntactic and Word Order Multi-Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In sentence similarity research methods, sentence similarity is often calculated from semantic aspects, however, the influence of other features is ignored. For example, the influence of sentence syntactic structure and word order on sentence similarity is not considered. Therefore, This paper proposes a method to measure the degree of similarity between sentences based on a multi-feature fusion of semantics, syntactic similarity and word order similarity, respectively. For the aspect of semantic similarity, in this paper, we first preprocess the sentence and obtain the word vectors, and then obtains sentence vector features through neural networks, so as to calculate the sentence semantic similarity; Finally, for the aspect of word order similarity, word order is considered as the auxiliary feature information to calculate sentence similarity since word order has a smaller effect on sentence similarity compared to the above information. The experimental results show that the proposed model has an accuracy of 77.4 % and an F1 value of 84.3% on the MRPC dataset.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Data Uploading Using Parking Resources After Disaster Rescue
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As an important device for disaster rescue, unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs) are usually limited by their batteries and computational power to perform complex computational tasks during the rescue process. In response to the above situation, it is proposed that the disaster rescue makes parked vehicles collaboratively perform the application tasks generated by UAVs. We organize parked vehicles into parking clusters.. Then, a task scheduling model of deep reinforcement learning(DRL) is built, in which multiple vehicles in the parking cluster are chosen to execute task data together to ensure the quality of experience(QoE) of UAVs. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves a lower execution cost and higher completion rate compared with other offloading strategies.

articleTitle: A Super-Resolution Multi-Target Location Algorithm for Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To solve the problems of low resolution and high complexity of location algorithm of frequency modulated continuous wave radar, a super-resolution multi-target location algorithm is proposed by improving sparse theory, eigenvalue decomposition and fast Fourier transform. Firstly, we construct a linear antenna array signal model, and derive a general guidance vector suitable for both far and near fields. In order to reduce the complexity, the Taylor approximation of the antenna's two-way echo distance is obtained. Then, based on the sparse hypothesis, a small scale Fourier dictionary is constructed in the rough estimated Intermediate frequency. By establishing the regularization optimization model, the high precision estimation of the target Intermediate frequency is achieved which can realize the super-resolution location in the distance. Then, the Multiple Signal Classification is used to estimate the angle. The simplifyed of the guiding vector and the reducing of the data dimension can reduce the complexity. Based on the above model, multi-target localization is realized. Finally, the range resolution and spatial Angle resolution are calculated, the spatial sampling process is analyzed, and the superiority of the proposed algorithm in super-resolution and low-complexity is verified.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity ICI Mitigation Processing for OFDM Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Conventional orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) radar shows serious performance degradation, in the presence of intercarrier interference (ICI). In this paper, we presented a repeated symbol scheme and Doppler compensation based on a modified DFT in OFDM radar, to resolve the ICI problem in achieving the high resolution range profile (HRRP) of the extend targets. The Doppler robustness of the proposed method creates new possibilities for system parameterization. Simulation results are provided to show that the proposed scheme is superior to the classical signal processing in improving HRRP performance.

articleTitle: Enterprise Credit Prediction Model Based on SCC-MIC-Boruta Algorithm Feature Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: A method combining Spearman Correlation Coefficient (SCC), Maximal Information Coefficient (MIC), and Boruta algorithm is proposed to address the problem of low classification accuracy of traditional machine learning algorithms when processing features of enterprise credit data. The method is applied to Decision Trees, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBOOST), and Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT). Firstly, SCC is used to remove highly correlated features, and then MIC is used to find the strongest correlation between features and labels. Next, Boruta is embedded in the Random Forest model to find the optimal feature subset. Finally, the optimal feature subset is applied to the three classification models. Experimental results show that the feature subset selected by this method improves the classification accuracy of the three classification models by 1.18%, 1.18% and 3.53%, respectively.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Model for Log Based on LSTM Network and Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Log-based anomaly detection is the key to ensuring that today's large-scale distributed systems can function properly. Analyzing log data that records the running status of software systems and quickly and accurately identifying abnormal parts is the primary task of maintaining system and software security and stability. The main contribution of this paper is the presentation of a new model combining LSTM network and variational autoencoder model: LogLVAE. The model includes a data preprocessing phase and an anomaly detection phase. In the data preprocessing phase, the current most efficient online log parsing algorithm, Drain, is used to parse the log data into log templates, and then the log template sequence is divided by the sliding window algorithm. In the anomaly detection phase, the model first uses LSTM to be able to extract semantic features of log sequences by contextual information, then reconstructs the input data by VAE, calculates the reconstruction error using the reconstructed data and the input data, and detects anomalies in log sequences and reports the results to the administrator if the reconstruction error exceeds a predefined threshold. The results of our experiments, which were based on two real log datasets, indicate that LogLVAE outperformed other algorithms in terms of overall performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Research of One-Bit Feedback Algorithms Based on UAV Swarm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: One-bit feedback algorithm is a commonly used phase synchronization algorithm in distributed beamforming, which can synchronize the phase of the signal emitted from distributed transmitting unit at the receiving end, thereby maximizing the received signal strength and achieving the purpose of long-distance transmission. Four one-bit feedback algorithms are introduced: one-bit feedback algorithm, one-bit feedback algorithm with variable directional perturbation, one-bit feedback algorithm using two time slots and one-bit feedback algorithm exploiting cumulative positive feedback information. The system model of distributed beamforming is constructed based on UAV swarm. Under the ideal condition and additive white Gaussian noise, the convergence rate of different algorithms is obtained, the performance of these algorithms is summarized, and the principle and the effect of different improvement methods are analyzed. The results indicate that one-bit feedback algorithm exploiting cumulative positive feedback information has the best performance under both experimental conditions, however, under the influence of strong noise, the three improved algorithms lose their robustness.

articleTitle: Heart Sound Segmentation based on an Improved DHMM with Shannon Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Each human cardiac cycle contains four heart sound components: first heart sound (S1), systolic, second heart sound (S2) and diastolic. Segmentation of heart sounds refers to the separation of acquired heart sounds according to cardiac cycle, which is of great significance for better classification and recognition of heart sounds. A cardiac cycle consists of four parts, which are S1, S2, systolic and diastolic. This paper studies how to accurately segment these four parts in PCG signal. Based on HMM, this paper proposes a new algorithm combining Support vector machine (SVM) and duration Hidden Markov model (DHMM) for heart sound segmentation, and uses normalized Shannon energy to extract envelope in DHMM. This model extracts the envelope of the original heart sound by normalized Shannon energy, and then uses Gaussian mixture distribution to model the state duration of the sample, and establishes the DHMM model, which solves the defect that the duration cannot be provided in HMM. Then, the extended Viterbi algorithm is used to infer the most possible state. Allows the model to extend beyond the beginning and end states of the PCG. Finally, different states of heart sounds were identified by SVM model. We used this model to segment the 30-40s PCG records of 123 unidentified adult patients. Experimental results show that the segmentation accuracy of the proposed algorithm is significantly improved compared with the reference algorithm. For normal heart sounds and pathologic heart sounds have achieved better segmentation effect.

articleTitle: Distributed Healthcare Information System Based on High-Concurrency Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
